commit bc910d85e112fa0c6fac5f485f338be58117ea6b
Date: Fri Dec 05 07:23:20 2014 +0000

Student Scheduling  - added ability to override the following reservation properties (for any reservation)    - reservation priority, must be used, can assign over limit, allow overlap (time conflicts)  - see the unitime.reservation.* application properties    - for instance set unitime.reservation.canOverLimit.group to true to allow students meeting a student group reservation to be enrolled over the course / ...

result.reasoning: This commit added the switch statement that assigns reservation properties (priority, canAssignOverLimit, mustBeUsed, allowOverlap) based on reservation type. It introduced a copy-paste error where the Group, Curriculum, and Course cases all incorrectly used ApplicationProperty.*Individual properties instead of their respective *Group, *Curriculum, and *Course properties. The fix commit corrects exactly this mistake by changing each case to reference its own type-specific ApplicationProperty. Git blame confirms all buggy lines trace directly to this single commit.
